blocks.alt: A pure machine and one with doors
blocks.description: Two machines. The pure one has a single input, the data, and a single output, the result. The other also has side doors: through one it reads, through others it writes and changes things outside, without it showing in the call.

caption.text: The pure machine has a single input and a single output. The other one has side doors through which things go in and out that you cannot see in the call.

points.text: An effect is reading, showing or changing something outside the subprogram.
A pure function has no effects: with the same data it always gives back the same, and the engine checks it.
